in_marathi.name: Chandrakant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrakant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chandrakant is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'kant' meaning adorned. This name signifies one who is adorned with the moon or the one who is the embodiment of the moon's cool and calming energy. It is also believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
